provenance.notes: Dot-matrix supermarket receipt, straight ASCII. Bottom line 'STEP IN SHOES NOW OPEN!' is clipped by the scan edge but legible. Tokens verified at zoom: PLATES7"48, CHRY8, T/HOUSE16BN, 96ZPP499.

method.transcriber: Claude (Fable 5), manual reading of each fixture at native resolution plus zoomed crops for small/ambiguous tokens; no OCR engine output was consulted while transcribing
conventions: Text is as-printed: line-break hyphenations keep their hyphen (Fraktur '=' transcribed as '-'), letterspaced (gesperrt) words written without intra-word spaces, typographic quotes/apostrophes kept where the source prints them, straight ASCII where the source is dot-matrix/monospace.
Reading order for multi-column pages is logical: left column top-to-bottom, then right column. Engines that emit raster order will be penalized on ordering; that is a real layout error.
Back-side bleed-through text (german_official_print.jpg) is NOT ground truth and is excluded.
